player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imaray {player_id} deg Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma i ɣezzifen {num_rounds} n tuffɣa.

Tasuddest n Urar:
- Uqbel kila tiɣri, ɣur-k {total_conversation_rounds} n tuffɣa akken ad tmeslay s leḥsab.
- S akken, snat n imarayen ttnadin ad ṣṣifen neɣ ad ṛṛan ɣer tneɣri.

Tafelwit n Tɣellist (teɣzif deg kila tuffɣa):
- Snat Ṣṣifen ➜ kila {cooperate_reward}
- Snat Ṛṛan ɣer tneɣri ➜ kila {mutual_defect_reward}
- Yiwen iṛa ɣer tneɣri, yiwen ṣṣifen ➜ Aṛa ɣer tneɣri {defect_reward}, Aṣṣif {sucker_reward}

Amek i wakken ad Uḍen:
- Deg wakud n tmeslayt: aru aɣawal i tebɣam.
- Deg wakud n tiɣri: ṛuḥ '[Cooperate]' neɣ '[Defect]' (war leḥsab n usekkil). Tzemreḍ ad ternuḍ aɣawal uffiɣ/sakin n token.

phases.conversation_finished: Asiwed yeqqimen i turda {round}. Ssawel s '[Cooperate]' neɣ '[Defect]' deg \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: Imezdaɣ-nni i sin llan ttekkan deg leqdic.
